scope: Chronological evidence for every local Explorer record, assembled from preserved IANA data, formal ICANN application archaeology including the complete local 2000/2004/2012 application-string graph, and curated local evidence. Browser-time gTLD contract/lifecycle enrichment is disabled. The 2026 Reveal-Day string inventory is a separate runtime Explorer layer and is not treated as local application-level life-history evidence.
ccTldMethod: IANA registration plus delegation/redelegation reports; gTLD Registry Agreement fields are not applied to ccTLDs.
evidenceRule: No missing date or historical phase is inferred. Only attributable, dated source evidence is rendered as a factual life-history event.
knownLimitation: Some early TLD operator changes predate central structured records and may remain undocumented in this dataset.
freezePolicy: Core life-history evidence is local and deterministic. The post-Reveal 2026 string inventory may be loaded separately at runtime from the documented secondary index; full local APS application-level coverage is not claimed.
